relationships.subject: JAK2
relationships.evidence_quote: Preclinical studies demonstrated that JAK2 and STAT3 inhibition reduced fibroblast proliferation and collagen deposition.

relationships.subject: tofacitinib
relationships.evidence_quote: A trial of tofacitinib, a JAK1/3 inhibitor, showed reduced scar thickness, pruritus, and pain.

key_findings: Systematic review: 23 studies; JAK2/STAT3 inhibition reduced keloid fibroblast proliferation and collagen deposition.
Tofacitinib trial reduced scar thickness, pruritus and pain.
